jsonld.description: A free, independent, student-built iPhone app for UC Santa Barbara students. It imports your GOLD schedule in about 30 seconds and brings your Today view, dining commons hours and menus, Canvas homework, registrar deadlines, friends' free time, classmate counts and historical grade distributions into one app. Not an official UCSB service.
featureList: 30-second GOLD schedule import (screenshot, in-app GOLD sign-in, or paste)
Today view: your next class, the gaps in your day, meals and what's due
Home-screen widgets and a lock-screen class countdown
Real UCSB dining commons hours and menus
Canvas homework, registrar deadlines and fee dates in one due list
Friends' free time: who's free now and when you're both free
Classmate discovery: friends in your classes and anonymous classmate counts
Historical UCSB grade distributions by instructor and quarter
Pass Time registration planner with first choices and backups
Live campus map with friends and campus events
Quarter Wrapped: your quarter in review
jsonld.name: Lagoon: UCSB Campus App

acceptedAnswer.text: Lagoon is the free all-in-one campus app for UCSB students. It combines GOLD schedule sync, real grade distribution data, live dining commons menus, campus events, Daily Nexus headlines, classmate discovery, and study groups in one app.
Yes. Lagoon is free to download on the App Store and there are no paid tiers.
Yes. Lagoon imports your registered courses from UCSB GOLD so your schedule, attendance, and finals countdown stay accurate.

mainEntity.name: Does Lagoon sync with UCSB GOLD?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snap a screenshot of your GOLD schedule and Lagoon reads it automatically — or sign in to GOLD, or paste your class list. Import takes about 30 seconds, and you get a Today view plus home-screen widgets.

mainEntity.name: How do I import my UCSB schedule into Lagoon?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grade distributions are aggregated from UCSB's publicly released grade reports — including average GPA, A-rate, and D/F-rate for over 500 courses.

mainEntity.name: Where does Lagoon's grade data come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lagoon is built exclusively for UCSB undergraduates and graduate students. Sign-in requires a valid UCSB account.
Lagoon is an independent, student-built app for the UCSB community. It is not an official university service.

Yes. Lagoon shows each dining commons' real hours for today and tomorrow, from UCSB Dining's own data, next to the dining commons menus. Hours change during breaks and holidays, and Lagoon follows them.

mainEntity.name: Does Lagoon show UCSB dining hall hours and menus?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Paste your Canvas calendar-feed link and Lagoon lists your assignments next to registrar deadlines, BARC fee dates and financial aid dates. The feed link stays on your phone.
